show.description: Billionaire Scam Bride tells the thrilling story of Zara, a con artist who marries tech billionaire Aryan Malhotra under false pretenses - only to find herself falling for him. When lies start to unravel and Aryan discovers her secret, Zara must choose between running away with the fortune or staying to fight for the love she never meant to find.
